annotations.title: Is this pay compliant, and what does a shortfall cost?

description: Compares pay for one classification with the Davis-Bacon prevailing rate (basic hourly rate + fringe from the wage determination; look it up with lookup_wage_determination) and, if short, computes the IRS cure: the shortfall (x3 for intentional disregard), interest at the Federal short-term rate + 6 points, and the $5,000 per-worker penalty ($10,000 for intentional disregard), with the penalty waivers (corrected by the quarter deadline and either no more than 10% of pay periods short or no more than 5% short; or work under a qualifying project labor agreement). Cash plus bona fide fringe contributions together must reach base plus fringe (29 CFR 5.31).

classification.description: The work classification (e.g. Electrician), for the record.

corrected_by_quarter_deadline.description: true if the back pay is made by the last day of the first month after the calendar quarter in which the failure occurred.

federal_short_term_rate_pct.description: Or give the Federal short-term rate (IRC 6621(b)) for the period yourself, in percent; the interest rate is that + 6 points.

fringe_paid_per_hour.description: Bona fide fringe benefit contributions per hour ($/hour): health, pension, insurance, vacation... not legally required benefits (29 CFR 5.29).

hours.description: Hours worked at this (short) pay: only the underpaid hours, to total the shortfall.

intentional_disregard.description: true if the failure was knowing or willful.

pay_periods_below.description: Of those, how many were paid below the prevailing rate.

pay_periods_total.description: Pay periods the worker was employed on the facility in the calendar year (for the small-failure waiver).

qualifying_project_labor_agreement.description: true if the work is under a pre-hire collective bargaining agreement for this project that meets 1.45-7(c)(6)(ii) and back pay is made before the credit is claimed (no penalty).

required_base_rate.description: The determination’s basic hourly rate for the classification ($/hour).

required_fringe_rate.description: The determination’s fringe benefit amount ($/hour); 0 if none.

wages_due_date.description: When the wages were due (YYYY-MM-DD): the server looks up that quarter’s Federal short-term rate (table through 2026-10-16) to show the interest rate.

workers.description: How many laborers or mechanics were paid this way (the penalty is per worker).

year_required_wages.description: The amount required to be paid to this worker for the calendar year (or the part of it) during which they worked on the facility: the 5% test in 1.45-7(c)(6)(i)(B) runs over the year, not over the underpaid hours alone.

year_wages_paid.description: What the worker was actually paid for that year on the facility (defaults to the year’s required wages less the shortfall entered).
